name: EU Settlement Scheme (Settled / Pre-Settled Status)
description: For EU/EEA/Swiss nationals who lived in the UK before 31 December 2020. Grants the right to continue living and working in the UK.
eligibility_summary: EU, EEA and Swiss nationals who were living in the UK before 31 December 2020 can apply for settled status (if they have lived in the UK for 5+ continuous years) or pre-settled status (less than 5 years). Applications are free. A separate Brexit-specific route to the right to remain.
